basic_details.job_title: VISL Recruitment 2026 - Apply Online for Revenue Consultant, Estate Officer and More Posts
basic_details.post_name: Advisor Land Matters, Revenue Consultant, Estate Officer
basic_details.short_information: Vizhinjam International Seaport (VISL) Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 22nd July 2026 on the official website. A total of 3 vacancies have been announced through the VISL Recruitment 2026 for the posts of Advisor Land Matters, Revenue Consultant, and Estate Officer.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 60 years for all posts.

qualification.education_qualification: Deputy Collector Rank (retired), Tahsildar Rank (retired), Tahsildar Rank or Rtd. Officer from Armed Forces
qualification.details: Advisor Land Matters (ALM): At the time of retirement, should have attained Deputy Collector Rank. Revenue Consultant (RC): At the time of retirement, should have at least attained Tahsildar Rank. Estate Officer (EO): At the time of retirement, should have at least attained Tahsildar rank or be a Retired Officer from the Armed Forces.

salary_details.details: Advisor Land Matters (ALM): Rs. 45,000/- Per Month Revenue Consultant (RC): Rs. 40,000/- Per Month Estate Officer (EO): Rs. 40,000/- Per Month

selection_process: Application Screening Criteria-based Screening Written Test Group Discussion Skill Test/Proficiency Test Interview
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the VISL Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of VISL to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. content_sections.heading: VISL Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Advisor Land Matters (ALM): At the time of retirement, should have attained Deputy Collector Rank. Revenue Consultant (RC): At the time of retirement, should have at least attained Tahsildar Rank. Estate Officer (EO): At the time of retirement, should have at least attained Tahsildar rank or be a Retired Officer from the Armed Forces.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the VISL Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of VISL to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the VISL recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the VISL recruitment is 05 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the different posts available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: The available posts are Advisor Land Matters (ALM), Revenue Consultant (RC), and Estate Officer (EO). Each post has specific eligibility criteria and salary structures.

faq.question: Q3. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts is 60 years. There is no mention of age relaxation for any category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Advisor Land Matters post?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Advisor Land Matters post is Rs. 45,000/- per month. This is a contract-based position.

faq.question: Q6. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Vizhinjam International Seaport (VISL), a government organization in Kerala.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies announced for the Advisor Land Matters, Revenue Consultant, and Estate Officer posts.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application for these posts?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these posts is strictly online. Candidates need to apply through the official VISL website.

faq.question: Q9. What are the key eligibility criteria for the Revenue Consultant post?
faq.answer: For the Revenue Consultant post, candidates must have attained at least Tahsildar Rank at the time of retirement.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for these positions?
faq.answer: The selection process involves Application Screening, Criteria-based Screening, Written Test, Group Discussion, Skill Test/Proficiency Test, and finally an Interview.
